sloka: स सुहृज् जनम् आमन्त्र्य वन वासाय निश्चितः ।इष्क्वाकु गुरुम् आमन्त्र्य जग्राह आयुधम् उत्तमम् ॥२-३१-३०॥
transliteration: sa suhṛj janam āmantrya vana vāsāya niścitaḥ ।iṣkvāku gurum āmantrya jagrāha āyudham uttamam ॥2-31-30॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, who was resolved to go to the forest, took leave of his friends, and collected from the house of Vasistha, preceptor of the Ikshvaku race, the powerful weapons deposited with him.
